helpHeading.message: Keep a post in three steps.

helpIntro.message: X Export is an independent tool for saving X posts and articles as documents. It is not affiliated with X Corp.

helpStep1.message: Sign in to X in this Chrome browser. Open a post detail or article reading view, expand Show more, and wait for the full body to load.

helpStep2.message: Click the extension icon and Read current post. Check the author and full text. Other loaded posts by the same author are optional and may be unrelated.

helpStep3.message: Markdown keeps image URLs. HTML embeds images for offline reading. PDF opens Chrome printing: choose Save as PDF, disable headers and footers, and enable background graphics if wanted.

helpLimits.message: Only content already loaded and visible to your X account is read. There is no automatic scrolling, hidden API access, video download or access-control bypass. Quoted images are not included. X page changes can affect extraction.

helpTrouble.message: Refresh X, expand the full text and read again from the detail page. Allow the image CDN permission for offline images; if denied or unavailable, an original-image link is kept. Save the PDF from the print dialog, not the downloads list.

helpData.message: Post text, author names/handles, source URLs, dates and image references are stored temporarily in Chrome’s extension session storage. Preferences stay in local storage. No developer server receives them. Preview images and export image requests contact X’s CDN.

helpClearNote.message: Clears saved previews in this browser session. Downloaded files, layout and language preferences are kept.

clearConfirm.message: Clear all temporary documents? Existing preview tabs will become unavailable. Downloaded files are kept.

clearFailed.message: Could not clear documents. Close Chrome to clear session data.

helpSupport.message: Use the support contact on the Chrome Web Store listing after release. Include the extension version, Chrome version and a public example URL. Never send passwords, cookies, tokens or private exported content.
